title: Requirements file that trusts an additional host
description: requirements.txt declares a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host.
limitation: It matches a `--trusted-host` entry that turns TLS verification off for that host in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
